page.layout: One page of text, centred at the top: title lines; below them a woodcut device with the legend around it; then the date beneath. A library stamp at the lower left (not transcribed).
page.notes: Woodcut device (oval with hands holding a cornucopia, legend "SERVATA FIDES" and "MATTHÆUS HARNISCH" around it, "DITATI" at lower left) is an engraving and is not transcribed as text. The date line is printed in old form "cIↄ. Iↄ. LXXXV." and is given as its ordinary numeral. The first line's initial "N" is a large decorative letter. Library stamp "Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München" omitted.
